evidence_policies.description: Positive factual answers must include candidate evidence refs or static report fields.
High-risk answers must include explicit review warning even when audit passes.
Answers based on candidate graph output must label the source state as preview/candidate.
No answer may present preview candidate output as campaign truth.

unknown_answer_examples.example: The preview does not resolve the exact horde size; keep it unknown and cite the remaining horde thread.

evidence_answer_examples.example: Lysandro appears as a preview candidate with cited source spans, not as approved memory.

high_risk_answer_examples.example: Warn that kinship recognition is high-risk and cite separate evidence spans without alias merging.

proposed_write_query_examples.example: Explain pending proposed write only; do not write memory.

query_to_source_expectations.positive_answers: candidate evidence refs or static report fields required
query_to_source_expectations.high_risk_answers: warning plus separate span notes required

query_result_boundary_language: Preview candidate memory is not durable campaign truth.
A safe answer must preserve evidence, uncertainty, and source state.
No answer may promote facts or canon.

agent_interaction_readiness.reason: Query vocabulary is static and does not execute retrieval. Agent Interaction must not consume candidate graph memory until approved durable graph memory and safe query execution exist.
